title: Auntie Ethel's Charm
summary: Break the charm to gain all six Enhance Ability effects until Long Rest.

fields.Effect: Advantage on ability checks for all six abilities, doubled carrying capacity, half falling damage, and 7 temporary HP.
fields.Acquisition: Auntie Ethel can reward it if you agree to her tadpole treatment.
fields.Base value: 30 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Activation: Break and consume the charm. Its effects last until Long Rest.

changes: Reconciled the item and linked gameplay rules with their pinned BG3 Wiki revisions, including item-specific qualifiers.
